item.text: I’m checking the current layout and source before changing anything else. The last refactor established package structure, so this pass should either tighten the API further or add the missing project scaffolding that makes the codebase easier to work with.

I’m making the next pass more behaviorally useful: the search result will become read-only, the demo will accept command-line input instead of only a hardcoded sample, and the tests will cover the broader `CharSequence` API plus immutability.
The refactor is in place. I’m compiling from the packaged source tree now and then I’ll run the demo and the updated test harness to verify the new CLI behavior and the immutable result contract.
I’ve confirmed the packaged build and the regression harness. I’m doing one last run with explicit CLI args so the new demo path is verified as well, not just the default sample.
I’m pulling exact line references now so the summary is precise. After that I’ll wrap with the files changed and the behavior I verified.

Refactored the codebase to make the search API safer and the demo more usable.

What changed:
- [NaivePatternSearch.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/048_naive_pattern_searching/src/main/java/naivepatternsearch/NaivePatternSearch.java#L14-L50)
  - `search` still uses the naive algorithm, but now returns an unmodifiable result list.
  - `pattern` and `text` stay as `CharSequence`, and the code now short-circuits the no-match case earlier.
  - The empty-pattern path is handled explicitly and immutably.
- [NaivePatternSearchDemo.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/048_naive_pattern_searching/src/main/java/naivepatternsearch/NaivePatternSearchDemo.java#L11-L31)
  - The demo now accepts optional CLI args: `pattern text`.
  - It still falls back to the sample input if no args are provided.
  - It prints a trailing newline and shows usage on invalid arg counts.
- [NaivePatternSearchTest.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/048_naive_pattern_searching/src/test/java/naivepatternsearch/NaivePatternSearchTest.java#L13-L47)
  - Added coverage for `CharSequence` inputs via `StringBuilder`.
  - Added a check that the returned list is unmodifiable.
  - Kept null and edge-case coverage.

Verified:
- `javac -d out $(rg --files src -g '*.java')`
- `java -cp out naivepatternsearch.NaivePatternSearchDemo`
- `java -cp out naivepatternsearch.NaivePatternSearchDemo aba ababa`
- `java -cp out naivepatternsearch.NaivePatternSearchTest`

If you want another pass, the next sensible refactor is adding a real build file so the project can be compiled and tested with one command.
